entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-03
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Adding a Shadow to a XAML element crashes the application on startup on Android in Release mode #31863
  • [.NET MAUI] Intune SDK (Microsoft.Intune.Maui.Essentials.Android) not compatible with .NET 9 – critical blocker for MAUI apps #31860
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `maui/release/10.0.1xx-rc2` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #31858

Closed

  • Step Into Breakpoints not working properly when running on Android devices #31850
  • [Android] Default `CornerRadius` is being converted `ToPixels` twice on `Button` #19077
  • Add Python support for reading WINISI .cal spectral data files #31861
  • Carouselview crashes when Itemsource was set to null since 9.0.80 #31760

PullRequests

Created

  • [Testing] Fix Bugzilla41842 test by replacing raw Page with ContentPage #31862
  • Invert NavigationPage UseMauiHandler flag #31859
    community ✨
